titulo_original: Bob and David Climb Machu Picchu

sinopsis.es: Bob Odenkirk y David Cross escalan Machu Picchu semanas después del infarto de Bob, impulsados por hojas de coca y su particular sentido del humor. A mayor altura, la comedia da paso a algo más revelador.
sinopsis.en: Bob Odenkirk and David Cross hike to Machu Picchu weeks after Bob's heart attack — fueled by coca leaves, altitude, and their particular brand of humor. As they climb higher, the comedy gives way to something more candid.
